procedure.title: Shift inspection
procedure.summary: The visual inspection a competent person begins before each shift. Record each item; a deficiency gets the next step and its rule.

procedure.title: Power line check before operations
procedure.summary: Identify the work zone, apply the 20-foot test, choose an option and put the precautions in place.

procedure.title: Ground conditions check
procedure.summary: Before assembly or use: firm, drained and graded ground, supporting materials, and known hazards below.

proc_step.text: Control mechanisms: check for maladjustments interfering with proper operation.
proc_step.detail: {"trainee":"Work each lever and pedal. Anything sticky or slow to respond is a finding.","operator":"Operate each control through its range with the engine running. Watch for sticking, lag or travel that does not match the function.","inspector":"Operate each control through its range with the engine running. Watch for sticking, lag or travel that does not match the function."}
proc_step.deficiency: {"guidance":"The competent person decides now whether this is a safety hazard.","action":"If it is a safety hazard, take the crane out of service until it is corrected.","section_id":"29cfr1926.1412(d)(2)","quote":"If the deficiency is determined to constitute a safety hazard, the equipment must be taken out of service until it has been corrected."}

proc_step.text: Control and drive mechanisms: excessive wear, and contamination by lubricants, water or other foreign matter.
proc_step.detail: {"trainee":"Look at linkages, clutches and brakes you can see without disassembly.","operator":"Look at linkages, clutches and brakes you can see without disassembly.","inspector":"Look at linkages, clutches and brakes you can see without disassembly."}
proc_step.deficiency: {"guidance":"The competent person decides now whether this is a safety hazard.","action":"If it is a safety hazard, take the crane out of service until it is corrected.","section_id":"29cfr1926.1412(d)(2)","quote":"If the deficiency is determined to constitute a safety hazard, the equipment must be taken out of service until it has been corrected."}

proc_step.text: Air, hydraulic and other pressurized lines: deterioration or leakage, especially lines that flex.
proc_step.detail: {"trainee":"Look along the hoses that bend when the boom or outriggers move. Wet or cracked hose is a finding.","operator":"Follow the hoses that move with the boom and outriggers. Wet spots, cracking and chafing are findings.","inspector":"Follow the hoses that move with the boom and outriggers. Wet spots, cracking and chafing are findings."}
proc_step.deficiency: {"guidance":"The competent person decides now whether this is a safety hazard.","action":"If it is a safety hazard, take the crane out of service until it is corrected.","section_id":"29cfr1926.1412(d)(2)","quote":"If the deficiency is determined to constitute a safety hazard, the equipment must be taken out of service until it has been corrected."}

proc_step.text: Hydraulic system: proper fluid level.
proc_step.detail: {"trainee":"Check the sight glass or dipstick in the manufacturer's stated boom position.","operator":"Check the sight glass or dipstick in the manufacturer's stated boom position.","inspector":"Check the sight glass or dipstick in the manufacturer's stated boom position."}
proc_step.deficiency: {"guidance":"The competent person decides now whether this is a safety hazard.","action":"If it is a safety hazard, take the crane out of service until it is corrected.","section_id":"29cfr1926.1412(d)(2)","quote":"If the deficiency is determined to constitute a safety hazard, the equipment must be taken out of service until it has been corrected."}

proc_step.text: Hooks and latches: deformation, cracks, excessive wear, or damage from chemicals or heat.
proc_step.detail: {"trainee":"Look for a bent or twisted hook and a latch that does not snap shut.","operator":"Check throat opening, twist and the latch closing fully. Compare against the manufacturer's criteria.","inspector":"Check throat opening, twist and the latch closing fully. Compare against the manufacturer's criteria."}
proc_step.deficiency: {"guidance":"The competent person decides now whether this is a safety hazard.","action":"If it is a safety hazard, take the crane out of service until it is corrected.","section_id":"29cfr1926.1412(d)(2)","quote":"If the deficiency is determined to constitute a safety hazard, the equipment must be taken out of service until it has been corrected."}

proc_step.text: Wire rope reeving: matches the manufacturer's specifications.
proc_step.detail: {"trainee":"Confirm parts of line and reeving pattern against the chart for today's configuration.","operator":"Confirm parts of line and reeving pattern against the chart for today's configuration.","inspector":"Confirm parts of line and reeving pattern against the chart for today's configuration."}
proc_step.deficiency: {"guidance":"The competent person decides now whether this is a safety hazard.","action":"If it is a safety hazard, take the crane out of service until it is corrected.","section_id":"29cfr1926.1412(d)(2)","quote":"If the deficiency is determined to constitute a safety hazard, the equipment must be taken out of service until it has been corrected."}

proc_step.text: Wire rope: inspect in accordance with 1926.1413(a).
proc_step.detail: {"trainee":"Running and standing ropes likely to be used this shift. Look for broken wires, kinks, crushing and corrosion.","operator":"Running and standing ropes likely to be used this shift. Look for broken wires, kinks, crushing and corrosion.","inspector":"Running and standing ropes likely to be used this shift. Look for broken wires, kinks, crushing and corrosion."}
proc_step.deficiency: {"guidance":"Wire rope deficiencies follow 1926.1413.","action":"Determine whether the deficiency is a safety hazard under 1926.1413 before using the rope.","section_id":"29cfr1926.1413(a)(1)","quote":"The inspection must consist of observation of wire ropes (running and standing) that are likely to be in use during the shift for apparent deficiencies"}

proc_step.text: Electrical apparatus: malfunction, excessive deterioration, dirt or moisture.
proc_step.detail: {"trainee":"Lights, horn, gauges and switches work; no moisture in panels.","operator":"Lights, horn, gauges and switches work; no moisture in panels.","inspector":"Lights, horn, gauges and switches work; no moisture in panels."}
proc_step.deficiency: {"guidance":"The competent person decides now whether this is a safety hazard.","action":"If it is a safety hazard, take the crane out of service until it is corrected.","section_id":"29cfr1926.1412(d)(2)","quote":"If the deficiency is determined to constitute a safety hazard, the equipment must be taken out of service until it has been corrected."}

proc_step.text: Tires (when in use): proper inflation and condition.
proc_step.detail: {"trainee":"Write down the lowest tire pressure you read, in psi.","operator":"Record the lowest tire pressure you measured, in psi. Compare with the manufacturer's value.","inspector":"Record the lowest tire pressure you measured, in psi. Compare with the manufacturer's value."}
proc_step.deficiency: {"guidance":"The competent person decides now whether this is a safety hazard.","action":"If it is a safety hazard, take the crane out of service until it is corrected.","section_id":"29cfr1926.1412(d)(2)","quote":"If the deficiency is determined to constitute a safety hazard, the equipment must be taken out of service until it has been corrected."}

proc_step.text: Ground conditions around the equipment: proper support, settling under outriggers, standing water.
proc_step.detail: {"trainee":"Walk each outrigger and pad. Look for settling, soft spots and water.","operator":"Walk each outrigger and pad. Look for settling, soft spots and water.","inspector":"Walk each outrigger and pad. Look for settling, soft spots and water."}
proc_step.deficiency: {"guidance":"Ground must support the equipment to the manufacturer's specifications.","action":"Stop and fix the support before use: mats, blocking or cribbing as needed.","section_id":"29cfr1926.1402(b)","quote":"The equipment must not be assembled or used unless ground conditions are firm, drained, and graded to a sufficient extent"}

proc_step.text: Level: within the manufacturer's tolerance, before each shift and after each move and setup.
proc_step.detail: {"trainee":"Read the level indicator after setup; relevel after any move.","operator":"Read the level indicator after setup; relevel after any move.","inspector":"Read the level indicator after setup; relevel after any move."}
proc_step.deficiency: {"guidance":"The competent person decides now whether this is a safety hazard.","action":"If it is a safety hazard, take the crane out of service until it is corrected.","section_id":"29cfr1926.1412(d)(2)","quote":"If the deficiency is determined to constitute a safety hazard, the equipment must be taken out of service until it has been corrected."}

proc_step.text: Operator cab windows: no significant cracks or breaks that hamper the view.
proc_step.detail: {"trainee":"Check every window the operator looks through for the lift.","operator":"Check every window the operator looks through for the lift.","inspector":"Check every window the operator looks through for the lift."}
proc_step.deficiency: {"guidance":"The competent person decides now whether this is a safety hazard.","action":"If it is a safety hazard, take the crane out of service until it is corrected.","section_id":"29cfr1926.1412(d)(2)","quote":"If the deficiency is determined to constitute a safety hazard, the equipment must be taken out of service until it has been corrected."}

proc_step.text: Safety devices and operational aids: proper operation.
proc_step.detail: {"trainee":"Ask a competent person to show you how each device is tested.","operator":"Test anti-two-block, boom angle indicator and load moment indicator per the manufacturer.","inspector":"Test anti-two-block, boom angle indicator and load moment indicator per the manufacturer."}
proc_step.deficiency: {"guidance":"Safety device and operational aid deficiencies follow 1926.1415 and 1926.1416.","action":"Take the action in 1926.1415 and 1926.1416 before using the equipment.","section_id":"29cfr1926.1412(d)(3)","quote":"the action specified in §§ 1926.1415 and 1926.1416 must be taken prior to using the equipment."}

proc_step.text: Notes and photos for the record.
proc_step.detail: {"trainee":"Anything else you saw, with photos of any finding.","operator":"Anything else you saw, with photos of any finding.","inspector":"Anything else you saw, with photos of any finding."}

proc_step.text: Identify the work zone: marked boundaries, or 360 degrees out to maximum working radius.
proc_step.detail: {"trainee":"Write down which method you used.","operator":"Write down which method you used.","inspector":"Write down which method you used."}
proc_step.deficiency: {"guidance":"The work zone must be identified before operations.","action":"Mark boundaries or use the full 360-degree zone.","section_id":"29cfr1926.1408(a)(1)(ii)","quote":"Defining the work zone as the area 360 degrees around the equipment, up to the equipment's maximum working radius."}

proc_step.text: Could any part of the equipment, load line or load get closer than 20 feet to a power line?

proc_step.text: Line voltage, confirmed with the utility (kV).

proc_step.text: Planning meeting held with the operator and workers in the area.
proc_step.detail: {"trainee":"Review the line's location and the steps to prevent encroachment.","operator":"Review the line's location and the steps to prevent encroachment.","inspector":"Review the line's location and the steps to prevent encroachment."}
proc_step.deficiency: {"guidance":"A planning meeting is required for Option 2 or 3.","action":"Hold the meeting before operations.","section_id":"29cfr1926.1408(b)(1)","quote":"Conduct a planning meeting with the operator and the other workers who will be in the area of the equipment or load"}
